description: Official .NET SDK for Serenity Star API
releaseNotes:
Version 2.4.0 - Message Feedback Comments Release

      NEW FEATURES:
      - Feedback Comments: SubmitFeedbackReq now accepts an optional Comment explaining why a message was rated that way
        * Limited to 1000 characters by the API, which rejects longer values with an HTTP 400 response
        * Blank comments are stored as no comment, and re-submitting feedback overwrites the previously stored comment

      - Message Feedback Retrieval: Audit the feedback submitted for a conversational agent
        * GetMessageFeedbackAsync(agentCode, GetMessageFeedbackReq) on Assistants and Copilots - Page through the feedback submitted for an agent, including comments
        * Supports paging (page size capped at 1000), date range filtering and sort direction
        * Requires an API key with the Audit permission for the agent, and returns end-user conversation content and user identifiers
        * Feedback is tied to a conversation message, so it is not available for Activities, Chat Completions or AI Proxies

      Version 2.3.0 - Agent-Scoped Volatile Knowledge Release

      NEW FEATURES:
      - Agent-Scoped Volatile Knowledge Upload: Upload volatile knowledge validated against an agent's configured allowed MIME types at upload time
        * UploadForAgentAsync(UploadVolatileKnowledgeReq) - Upload a file or content scoped to the agent
        * UploadFromFileForAgentAsync(UploadVolatileKnowledgeFromFileReq) - Upload from an existing file ID
        * UploadFromUrlForAgentAsync(UploadVolatileKnowledgeFromUrlReq) - Upload from a URL
        * UploadFromBase64ForAgentAsync(UploadVolatileKnowledgeFromBase64Req) - Upload from base64-encoded content
        * GetAllowedMimeTypesAsync() - Retrieve the MIME types allowed for the agent (falls back to all platform-supported types when none are configured)

      - Volatile Knowledge Metadata: VolatileKnowledgeRes now exposes FileId, EmbeddingsGenerated, and Scanned

      IMPROVEMENTS:
      - The existing subtenant-scoped UploadAsync remains available for uploads without agent-level MIME type validation

      Version 2.2.0 - Transcription and Audio Input Release

      NEW FEATURES:
      - AI Services Scope: New top-level AIServices scope for accessing AI-powered services
        * client.AIServices.Transcription for audio/video transcription

      - Audio Transcription:
        * TranscribeAsync(TranscribeAudioReq) - Upload and transcribe audio/video files directly
        * Supported formats: mp3, mp4, mpeg, mpga, m4a, wav, webm (max 25 MB)
        * Returns transcript text, metadata, token usage, and cost
        * Optional model selection, prompt guidance, user tracking, and channel

      - Agent Audio Input: Send audio file streams to agents for automatic upload, transcription and processing
        * Conversational agents (Assistants/Copilots): Pass audioStream and audioFileName to SendMessageAsync or StreamMessageAsync
        * Activity agents: Set AudioFileStream and AudioFileName on AgentExecutionReq
        * Chat Completion agents: Set AudioFileStream and AudioFileName on ChatCompletionReq
        * message and audioStream are mutually exclusive — providing both throws ArgumentException

      IMPROVEMENTS:
      - ChatCompletionReq.Message is now nullable (string?) to support audio-only requests
      - ChatCompletionReq.Validate() method for mutual exclusion validation
      - Conversation.SendMessageAsync and StreamMessageAsync: new overloads accepting (Stream audioStream, string audioFileName) for audio input

      Version 2.1.0 - API Enhancement Release

      IMPROVEMENTS:
      - Agent Version Management: Simplified agent version specification
        * Pass optional agent version directly as method parameters instead of using AgentVersion property
        * Activities.Create(agentCode, version, options)
        * Assistants.CreateConversation(agentCode, version, options)
        * ChatCompletions.Create(agentCode, version, options)
        * GetInfoByCodeAsync(agentCode, version, options) support for versioned agent info retrieval

      - API Refactoring: Cleaner and more intuitive method signatures
        * Removed AgentVersion property from ChatCompletionReq and AgentExecutionReq
        * Version parameter is now consistently passed at creation time
        * Improved method overloads for better discoverability

      - Code Quality:
        * Better separation of concerns in version handling
        * Consistent parameter ordering across all agent types
        * Enhanced XML documentation for clarity

      Version 2.0.1 - Hotfix
      - Fixed GuardrailRuleViolation.Rule property type from string to int to match API response
      - Simplified GuardrailRuleViolation constructors removing automatic RuleName assignment

      Version 2.0.0 - Major Release

      BREAKING CHANGES:
      - Renamed SerenityAIHubClient to SerenityClient
      - Complete API redesign to provide scoped methods based on agent types and other core entities (e.g., client.Agents.Activities.ExecuteAsync("agent-name"), conversation.SendMessageAsync("message"))

      NEW FEATURES:
      - Builder Pattern for Client Creation:
        * SerenityClientBuilder with fluent API for flexible configuration
        * Support for custom HttpClient injection
        * Configurable timeouts and base URLs

      - Volatile Knowledge Management: Upload and manage temporary documents (files or text) that can be used in agent executions with expiration control
        * client.Agents.VolatileKnowledge.UploadAsync() - Upload documents or text content
        * client.Agents.VolatileKnowledge.GetStatusAsync() - Check processing status
        * Support for embeddings processing, custom expiration dates, and callback URLs
        * Use volatile knowledge IDs in agent executions for context-aware responses

      - Enhanced Connector Support: Better integration with external services
        * conversation.GetConnectorStatusAsync(connectorId) - Check connection status for external services
        * Support for ConnectionPendingAction with connector details (ConnectorId, Url, ConnectorName, ConnectorImgUrl)
        * Improved handling of pending actions requiring user authentication
        * Support for connector authentication workflows in conversations

      - Unified Streaming Experience: Consistent streaming across all agent types
        * Activities: activity.StreamAsync()
        * Chat Completions: chatCompletion.StreamAsync()
        * AI Proxy: proxy.StreamAsync()
        * Assistants: conversation.StreamMessageAsync()
        * Receive real-time updates with start, content, task logs, and stop events

      IMPROVEMENTS:
      - Enhanced error handling with detailed HTTP error messages
      - Improved XML documentation across all public APIs
      - Better type safety and null handling
      - Consistent parameter naming and structure

      DOCUMENTATION:
      - Updated execution examples for all agents
      - Streaming examples for each agent type
      - Step-by-step guides for volatile knowledge workflows
      - Connector integration patterns
